front.title: Distributed Bandwidth Management for Segment Routing

abstract.t: This document defines an architecture for distributed bandwidth management in Segment Routing (SR) networks. Distributed bandwidth management is a model in which the bandwidth required by each SR Policy is computed and reserved in a distributed manner by the network nodes themselves, rather than by a centralized controller, so that path computation, admission control, and bandwidth accounting for SR Policies are performed by the head-end and transit nodes along the path.
